headline: Weathered Expanse And Mooring County Flare As Frontline Clashes Mount
war_summary: Fresh clashes have erupted across Weathered Expanse and Mooring County, where strategic installations exchanged hands during the past two hours amid climbing engagement rates. In Weathered Expanse, intense combat claimed over 4,200 combined casualties across the two-hour window alongside three base turnovers centered around Frostmarch. Mooring County also renewed active fighting with two base shifts at The Wind Hills. Meanwhile, the rapid base exchanges previously reported in Linn of Mercy and Stlican Shelf have paused, yet both sectors continue to endure brutal attrition, registering over 3,200 and 3,400 losses respectively in the last two hours with accelerating casualty trends. Dead Lands has similarly surged in violence, posting nearly 1,700 casualties in the latest two-hour interval under accelerating pressure. In contrast, Callahan's Passage has cooled sharply from its earlier bloodletting, joining stabilized sectors like Fisherman's Row and Stonecradle where territorial lines have held steady.
